question: What nature of the threefold division does Śiva promise to explain?
premises: Śiva responds to the request for clarification.
The subject is described as consisting of Śiva and Śakti.
The explanation is addressed to the sinless goddess.
inference: Śiva promises to explain that threefold division as consisting of Śiva and Śakti.
plain_english: O sinless one, I will tell you that it consists of Śiva and Śakti.
